quest.title: Lifting the Veil
quest.description: There we go. Dear mortal,the time has come for our sweet parting of ways, given that you have come this far and not managed to stab yourself in the face or melt your feet to the ground. It has been a special time for me, I do not doubt I shall forget you mere moments after we part. You may thus consider yourself stamped with my official seal of approval! Go little mortal, go into the world and try not to get maimed too much.

node.journal_entry: That said, I have other fledgling adventurers to "mortal-sit" now, you can find your own way out I trust. Simply move further down the vale and find my specially designed helpers to lead you out.

node.instruction: Find and Interact with the Arcane Terminal further down the path.
node.journal_entry: Tangerine Alert! Vale departure nexus has been compromised. Unknown entities have stolen activation rod. Further investigation may be required. Arcane terminals further down the vale will hold further details.

node.tag: If the player strikes the Golem
node.journal_entry: This enemy is beyond your skill Mortal, you had best run to fight another day! Be wary when you leave this Vale. You will encounter many such enemies in the world without, learn when to run and fight another day!

node.tag: Recieve Portal Shard - all of node
Find the entrance to the exit
node.journal_entry: Leylines have been synchronised - knowledge has been imparted. A new shard has been summoned, please proceed to the exit. Thank you for your time in the Vale and have a pleasant reanimation.

Alternatively, should the device remain intact, it can be extracted directly from the unknown entities that are permeating the lower portions of the vale.
Initiation of the Vale: The vale came into being as a necessary form of siphoning souls back into the world after a semi-extinction level event of spiritually significant proportions.

The Custodian: Little is known of the enigmatic custodian of the vale. A guide to fledgling souls seeking to re-enter the world of Agon, the Custodian makes sure that those who would fight in the Unholy Wars will re-enter the world with at least a level of competence required to weild blade or spell without slaying their allies by mistake.

Re-entry into Agon: The world without the vale is, from a mortal point of view, one that is re-awakening after a semi-extinction level event. Agon is being repopulated as quickly as the vale releases souls who have found their way back. Further information must be sought in Agon itself.
